cues: Five carbons must be split around the oxygen, either one plus four, or two plus three.
One plus four gives the methoxybutanes, and a butyl group has four arrangements, so four ethers.
Two plus three gives the ethoxypropanes, with two arrangements of propyl.
Any methoxybutane with any ethoxypropane is a pair of metamers.
